test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: What price should Kunal mark on a pair of pants which costs him ₹3,300, so as to gain 33% after allowing a successive discount of 25% and 30%?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (C.P) = ₹3,300

Gain = 33%

Successive Discounts = 25% and 30%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (S.P) = Cost Price × (1 + Gain%)

Marked Price (M.P) = Selling Price / (1 - Discount 1) × (1 - Discount 2)

**Calculation:**

S.P = ₹3,300 × (1 + 33/100)

⇒ S.P = ₹3,300 × 1.33

⇒ S.P = ₹4,389

M.P = ₹4,389 / [(1 - 25/100) × (1 - 30/100)]

⇒ M.P = ₹4,389 / [(0.75) × (0.70)]

⇒ M.P = ₹4,389 / 0.525

⇒ M.P = ₹8,360

**The marked price Kunal should set is ₹8,360.**
